remarks: Complete renovation of this unit at the Old Greenwich Gables. Open living space with great lighting, beautiful floors, stunning white kitchen, new baths, custom moldings, top of the line appliances. Fabulously designed kitchen that has great light. Primary bedroom suite has an attractive large bath. The second bedroom has a full bath. There is a balcony room with distance views to the golf course. The living room has a fireplace. There is a washer and dryer in the unit. This complex has a large outdoor pool and a health club with a gym, squash court and social room. Close to the train station and near the center of Old Greenwich and Tod's Point. Convenient location, one floor living. Elevator. Underground parking available.
